attachments.bestEffortPlaintext: Very severe COPD, GOLD 4. FEV1 0.71 L, 26% predicted. Home oxygen 2 L/min. Two admissions this year, BiPAP in February, never intubated. Prognosis guarded. Goals-of-care discussion deferred to next visit. Consider palliative care referral. ZEBRA-MARKER-IN-NOTE.
Admitted with COPD exacerbation and pneumonia. Treated with steroids and antibiotics, seven days. Echocardiogram: ejection fraction 55%. Discharged home. Code status: full code, not discussed.
